text:
mari: Heads-up: planning a staggered design-partner pilot for our Private offering. Need to lock intake fields, acceptance gates, and what we commit to partners for logs/observability

alex_r: Sounds good. One or two-step intake? quick interest form then deep eligibility?

june: Two-step. Step A = lightweight sign-up (company, use case, interest level). Step B = technical details + compliance flags. Keeps noise down.

mari: Draft for step A: company name, primary contact, short pilot goals, rough expected volume (low/med/high), and whether they handle regulated data. Step B: network type (VPC/on-prem/cloud), KMS/SSO needs, model families they want, allowed log granularity.

alex_r: For "allowed log granularity" capture choices: none, aggregated metrics only, request-level traces (redact PII), full token traces. This drives Console features and what we surface in private deployments.

mari: Also need explicit acceptance gates per wave: infra provisioned, onboarding checklist completed, two successful smoke tests within latency SLA. Wave sizes?

june: Wave 1 = 3 partners (fast cycle), Wave 2 = 6-8 (scale checks). Keep additional waves contingent on infra/observability polish.

tom: Legal: anything that exposes partner logs with personal data needs a DPA and explicit partner sign-off. We'll prepare a short DPA summary; no full contracts before they opt in.

mari: Can you produce a one-page DPA summary we link from the intake? We want partners to sign minimal thing for pilot access.

tom: Yep. Will also prepare an NDA + data processing addendum template for regulated sectors (fin/reg).

alex_r: Ops ask: we should capture "support runway" per partner in intake (e.g., X dev-days during onboarding). That way eng can budget ramp support.

june: Also capture feedback cadence commitment: weekly syncs for first month, then biweekly. Partners should upload a 20-50 prompt sample set for quality tracking.

mari: Proposed success criteria: 1) stability (<=1 production incident/week), 2) quality metrics valid against partner prompt set (pass threshold), 3) product engagement or ROI signal within pilot window.

alex_r: Add a fallback/rollback clause: automatic routing to fallback model if quality dips or latency spikes. Needs to be in intake as "safety net".

mari: Timeline: intake + DPA draft by EOW, invite list for wave1 by next Tue, onboarding runbook by next Fri. Everyone ok?

june: I'll own the onboarding checklists and runbook.

alex_r: I'll draft the observability toggle options and a minimal config YAML for partners to upload.

tom: I'll draft the DPA one-pager and attach NDA template.

mari: dp-bot: please create candidate spreadsheet and calendar placeholders for wave1 outreach when the list is ready

dp-bot: created board "dp-staggered-pilot" and spreadsheet stub at /product/pilots/dp-staggered-pilot.csv. Invited Mari, Alex_R, June, Tom as editors :white_check_mark:

mari: Great. Quick ask: drop 3 must-have intake fields into the sheet by EOD tomorrow. Keep it short.

alex_r: I'll add infra type, desired obs granularity, latency SLO.

june: I'll add onboarding support hours, prompt sample upload, security contact for scans.

tom: I'll add compliance flags (SOC2/ISO), DPA link, and NDA status field.

mari: Thanks. We'll reconvene Thurs 10am to approve the final intake before outreach.

(note: thread intentionally concise to mimic Slack style)
